title: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard for connecting AI agents to outside tools; keep "MCP" as is. This section connects the person's own MCP servers so their socios (AI agents) can call those servers' tools.
intro: "Socio" is the product name; "socios" are its AI agents. HTTPS and MCP stay as they are. "The provider" is the company or service running the MCP server.
failed: Error shown when a connection action failed without a message from the server.
loading: Shown while the list of the person's MCP connections loads.
form.name: Label of the field for a name the person picks for the new connection.
form.url: Label of the field for the address of the MCP server to connect. Keep "MCP" and "URL" as they are.
form.authentication: Label of the select choosing how Socio signs in to the MCP server.
form.oauth: OAuth is the name of an authorization standard; don't translate it.
form.none: Option of the Authentication select: the MCP server needs no sign-in.
form.add: Button: adds the new MCP connection with the name and address above.
status: A connection's state. The base form is a fallback: {{state}} is the raw state. The contexts are the states: draft (just added), authorizing (waiting for the provider's sign-in), review (sign-in done, tools to review), connected, disconnected, error.
actions.review: Button: look up the provider's OAuth details and review them before signing in there.
actions.refresh: Button: fetch the server's list of tools again (this clears the grants).
actions.disconnect: Button on a connection: clears Socio's credentials and the tool grants, keeping the connection in the list.
actions.remove: Button on a connection: deletes the connection from the list.
authorize.label: Accessible name of the panel reviewing the provider's OAuth details.
authorize.issuer: {{issuer}} is the URL of the OAuth server that will sign the person in.
authorize.resource: {{resource}} is the URL of the MCP server the access is for.
authorize.scopes: OAuth scopes are named permissions the provider can grant; the person picks which to ask for.
authorize.noScopes: Shown in the authorization review when the provider lists no optional OAuth scopes (named permissions) to pick.
authorize.required: {{scopes}} is a comma-separated list of scope names the MCP server said it needs.
authorize.client: Expandable section: use an OAuth client (app registration) the person set up with the provider themselves.
authorize.clientNote: "Callback" is the address the provider returns to after sign-in.
authorize.clientId: Label of the field for the OAuth client's ID (an identifier from the provider). Keep "OAuth" as is.
authorize.clientSecret: Label of the field for the OAuth client's secret, a password the provider issued.
authorize.continue: Button: go to the provider's own page to sign in and approve.
tools.socio: Label of the select picking which socio (AI agent) the tool grants are for.
tools.allowed: Heading of the checkboxes for the tools the chosen socio may call.
tools.unavailable: Shown under a tool Socio can't call; {{reason}} is the server's explanation.
tools.schema: Expandable section with the tool's technical definition (JSON).
tools.empty: Shown when the MCP server's list of tools (its catalog) is empty.
tools.save: Button: save which tools the chosen socio (AI agent) may call.
